name: metrics_diag
description: Metrics of one diag tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned to its CPU

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

bundle_state.description: Bundle subsystem state: 0=disconnected (All bundle tiles disconnected), 1=connecting (At least one bundle tile connecting, none connected or sleeping), 2=connected (At least one bundle tile connected), 3=sleeping (At least one bundle tile sleeping, none connected), 4=disabled (No bundle tiles configured)

connecting.description: At least one bundle tile connecting, none connected or sleeping

connected.description: At least one bundle tile connected

sleeping.description: At least one bundle tile sleeping, none connected

vote_state.description: Vote subsystem state: 0=disabled (Non-voting or no tower tile), 1=not_started (Tower tile not running or no votes cast yet), 2=delinquent (Vote distance exceeds threshold or vote stalled), 3=voting (Voting normally), 4=inadmissible (Voting, but the vote account fails the validator admission ticket filter)

not_started.description: Tower tile not running or no votes cast yet

delinquent.description: Vote distance exceeds threshold or vote stalled

inadmissible.description: Voting, but the vote account fails the validator admission ticket filter

replay_state.description: Replay subsystem state: 0=disabled (No replay tile), 1=not_started (Replay tile not running or slots are zero), 2=behind (Replay lagging behind turbine or reset slot stalled), 3=running (Replay keeping up)

not_started.description: Replay tile not running or slots are zero

behind.description: Replay lagging behind turbine or reset slot stalled

turbine_state.description: Turbine subsystem state: 0=disabled (No shred or replay tiles), 1=not_started (Tiles not all running or turbine slot is zero), 2=stalled (Turbine slot not advancing), 3=repair_outpacing (Repair byte throughput exceeds turbine), 4=running (Turbine receiving normally)

not_started.description: Tiles not all running or turbine slot is zero

builder_state.description: External block builder subsystem state: 0=disabled (No block builder configured), 1=disconnected (Block builder disconnected), 2=connecting (Block builder connection in progress), 3=unhealthy (Connected, but the block builder is not in a usable state), 4=connected (Block builder connected and healthy)

unhealthy.description: Connected, but the block builder is not in a usable state

system_device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs across all CPUs

device_irq_on_tile_cpu.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on CPUs dedicated to pinned tiles; subset of SystemDeviceIrq

system_softirq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Soft-IRQs across all CPUs, by softirq type

other.description: e.g. TIMER, HRTIMER, IRQ_POLL, TASKLET, SCHED, RCU, ...

softirq_on_tile_cpu.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Soft-IRQs on CPUs dedicated to pinned tiles, by softirq type; subset of SystemSoftirq

other.description: e.g. TIMER, HRTIMER, IRQ_POLL, TASKLET, SCHED, RCU, ...

cpu_package_millicelsius.description: Hottest CPU package temperature (k10temp Tctl or coretemp Package), 0 if no sensor

nic_millicelsius.description: Hottest NIC ASIC temperature (mlx5 or ice), 0 if no sensor

nvme_millicelsius.description: Hottest NVMe composite temperature, 0 if no sensor or the kernel lacks CONFIG_NVME_HWMON

cpu_power_microwatts.description: CPU package power from the powercap (RAPL) energy counters, averaged over 5 s, 0 if unavailable

system_power_microwatts.description: Whole-system power draw from the ACPI power meter, averaged over its interval, 0 if no meter

memory_ecc_corrected.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Corrected memory ECC errors across all memory controllers since boot (EDAC), 0 if firmware handles errors instead

memory_ecc_uncorrected.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Uncorrected memory ECC errors across all memory controllers since boot (EDAC), 0 if firmware handles errors instead

system_load_centi.description: Load average over each window, times 100 (/proc/loadavg has two decimals)

system_cpu_duration_nanos.description: CPU time summed over all CPUs since the diag tile started, by state (/proc/stat), 10 ms resolution

memory_available_bytes.description: Host memory available without swapping (/proc/meminfo available)

memory_free_bytes.description: Host memory not in use at all (/proc/meminfo free)

swap_in_bytes.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Bytes swapped in from disk since boot (pswpin)

swap_out_bytes.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Bytes swapped out to disk since boot (pswpout)

system_page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults across the host since boot (pgmajfault)

oom_killed.description: Processes killed by the kernel OOM killer since boot (oom_kill)

cpu_pressure_duration_nanos.description: Time at least one task stalled waiting for CPU since boot (PSI some), 0 if the kernel lacks PSI

memory_pressure_duration_nanos.description: Time at least one task stalled on memory reclaim or swap since boot (PSI some), 0 if the kernel lacks PSI

memory_pressure_full_duration_nanos.description: Time all non-idle tasks stalled on memory together since boot (PSI full), a subset of MemoryPressureDurationNanos

io_pressure_duration_nanos.description: Time at least one task stalled on IO since boot (PSI some), 0 if the kernel lacks PSI

io_pressure_full_duration_nanos.description: Time all non-idle tasks stalled on IO together since boot (PSI full), a subset of IoPressureDurationNanos

accounts_disk_read_bytes.description: Bytes read from the accounts disk since boot (/sys/block stat sectors read), 0 if not on a block device

accounts_disk_written_bytes.description: Bytes written to the accounts disk since boot (/sys/block stat sectors written), 0 if not on a block device

accounts_disk_written.description: Write requests the accounts disk completed since boot (/sys/block stat writes completed), 0 if not on a block device

accounts_disk_write_duration_nanos.description: Time write requests to the accounts disk spent from submission to completion since the diag tile started, summed over requests (/sys/block stat write ticks), 0 if not on a block device

accounts_disk_busy_duration_nanos.description: Time the accounts disk had at least one request in flight since the diag tile started (/sys/block stat io_ticks), 0 if not on a block device

accounts_disk_request_in_flight_integral.description: Integral of requests in flight at the accounts disk over time since the diag tile started (request-nanoseconds, /sys/block stat time_in_queue); divide by elapsed time for the average queue depth, 0 if not on a block device

accounts_disk_request_in_flight.description: Requests the accounts disk had in flight at the last sample (/sys/block stat in_flight), 0 if not on a block device
